purpose: Sample applicant file for the signed report a manager receives when they ask for one (krizaka-internal#3119).
noRealPerson: Every person, employer, bank and address is invented. Surnames carry a marker word, postal codes use the letter D (never issued), the SIN-like number starts with 0 and is invalid.
madeBy: node scripts/sample-file/build.mjs — the text is scripts/sample-file/documents.mjs, rendered by scripts/demo-documents/render.mjs (pdf-lib, fixed dates).
